quotes.text: Customer service took care of me just fine, captain was cool, first mate was chill, they let us have our fun on the boat and have a great time. The trip was filled with beautiful sights and was very pleasant.

quotes.author: Mark O Matic
quotes.text: Rented pontoon boat online, all went well, folks were at the dock to meet us & explain dos & don'ts. No issue with boat, went on 4 hour cruise, they were there to dock us when we returned too.

quotes.author: Curtie
quotes.text: We took an 8 hour rental on a Sunday afternoon. It was awesome! The boat was clean and newer. We maxed it out with 10 people and we had plenty of room even with coolers.
We love taking groups out. It makes Milwaukee shine. Make sure to schedule so you can see the sunset. The team who gets you set up are amazing!

quotes.author: Krista Flemming
quotes.text: Great fun! Perfect way to see the city and enjoy the water! LOVED it! Easy to captain and maneuver through the area. Will do it again!
